summary.title: Practical Vim, Second Edition
summary.one_liner: A tip-based book that teaches Vim 8 editing techniques, from the Dot Formula and macros to project-wide search and replace, without needing plugins.
takeaways: Use the Dot Formula: one keystroke to target a change and one to execute it, then repeat with the dot command
Record keystrokes as a macro to automate complex repetitive tasks
Use Vim's 'very magic' regex mode and iterate on search history to build complex patterns
Search across multiple files and run substitute on the results for project-wide search and replace, with no plugins
summary.summary: This is a second-edition book (updated for Vim 8, 354 pages, published October 2015 with a 2017 revision) organized as more than 120 tips. It covers modes, managing files, navigation, registers, macros, patterns and search, substitution, global commands, and tools such as ctags, the quickfix list, grep/vimgrep, autocompletion, and the spell checker. The page presents it as suited to beginner and intermediate Vim users. The page text does not state the level explicitly, so it is recorded as mixed. Ebook formats are sold for $26.95 USD.
